description: MCP server conditions deny prod_db while allowing the approved github MCP server.
laneYaml:
id: rt-mcp-server-lane
version: 1
priority: 2000
mode: enforce
purpose: Restrict MCP servers available to coding agents.
appliesTo: { surfaces: [claude-code], agents: ['rt-mcp-server-lane'] }
failMode: { default: closed, READ: open, MCP: closed }
rules:
  deny:
    - id: prod-db-mcp-denied
      mcpServer: [prod_db]
  allow:
    - id: github-mcp-allowed
      mcpServer: [github]
  judge: []
  approve: []
defaultVerdict: deny
approval: { channels: [dashboard], timeoutSec: 1 }
judge: { escalateBelow: 0.7, dataPolicy: redacted }

steps.text: Open an issue for the failing test.
